title: eng hiring & onboarding - interview debriefs + weekly sync 2026-03-11
content:
Weekly hiring/onboarding sync notes - platform engineering (Priya)
Date: 2026-03-11 10:00-10:45 PT
Attendees: Priya Nair (chair), Liam O'Connor, Sofia Chen, Marcus Lee, Evelyn Park, hiring-ops (read-in)

Objectives:
- Quick debriefs for candidates interviewed last week
- Onboarding check-in for new joiners (Carlos, Mei)
- Team-health pulse + immediate blockers
- Action items and next steps for interview scheduling and offer approvals

1) Interview debriefs (summary table style, shorthand)
- Candidate: "A - infra backend" (screen + onsite loop 2026-03-09)
  - Interviewers: Liam (system design), Marcus (runtime), Sofia (prod infra)
  - Strengths: clear design tradeoffs, prior infra scale experience (latency SLAs), strong debugging examples
  - Concerns: limited experience with model-serving specifics (KV cache patterns) but quick learner
  - Score: 4/5 overall; consensus = strong hire if comp aligns (can be L4/L5 depending).
  - Next: hiring-ops to draft comp band proposal; follow-up reference check (Marcus).

- Candidate: "B - infra SRE-ish" (onsite 2026-03-08)
  - Interviewers: Evelyn (SRE), Priya (culture/fit), Liam (service ops)
  - Strengths: excellent incident postmortems, tooling focus (observability), familiarity with multi-tenant GPU ops
  - Concerns: not deep on Python performance tuning; some AWS-only assumptions
  - Score: 3.5/5; consensus = hire for L4 with strong mentorship; consider for infra-ops track.
  - Next: offer loop (Evelyn to lead); check manager bandwidth for onboarding plan.

- Candidate: "C - infra infra (junior)" (phone screen 2026-03-07)
  - Interviewers: Sofia, Marcus
  - Strengths: motivated, has open-source contributions (small), good fundamentals
  - Concerns: gaps on distributed systems debugging, needs structured ramp plan
  - Score: 2.5/5; consensus = hold / consider for SWE-I internship or IC1 in future; pass for full-time hire now.

Notes/flags:
- Need clearer rubric for "model-serving familiarity" vs general infra; Priya to draft a 1-page rubric for interviews (target: add to Confluence and share with interviewers) - ACTION: Priya by 2026-03-18 -> Confluence: CONFLUENCE-ENG-ONBOARD-2026
- Standardize score mapping to hiring-ops approval flow (JIRA-2108).

2) Onboarding sync (new joiners)
- Carlos (started 2026-03-02, infra eng)
  - Completed: account onboarding, local dev env, first-week checklist items 1-6
  - In progress: pair sessions with Liam on runtime infra (KV cache design), reading list for serving runtime optimizations
  - Blockers: missing access to GPU dev pool in us-west-2 for perf tests (perm error) -> infra-iam ticket JIRA-2134 created (Marcus).
  - Mentorship: assigned to Liam (shadowing plan), weekly 1:1 scheduled Mondays 11am PT

- Mei (started 2026-03-09, SRE)
  - Completed: SRE runbooks review, pager rotation intro, alerting dashboards review
  - In progress: taking on small oncall shifts, working through runbook for GPU node degradation
  - Blockers: needs KMS key access for a private test cluster (security approval pending) -> security flagged; Evelyn to escalate.
  - Early wins: automated a small dashboard alert filter to reduce noise (PR open: github PR #512).

Onboarding notes / suggestions:
- Add a "model-serving primer" doc to the onboarding reading list (short, 30-min) that highlights KV cache, batching, and common perf pitfalls. ACTION: Marcus + Sofia to draft by 2026-03-20.
- Consider a 2-week "paired rotation" for infra hires where they rotate across runtime, serving, and ops; reduces siloing and shortens time-to-contribution. Discuss with eng managers next week.

3) Team health / pulse
- Current headcount update: hiring plan reviewed in planning doc; open reqs: 3 infra engineers (2 backend, 1 SRE), 1 release engineer.
- Overtime / capacity: signals show a spike last sprint around release cut 2026-03-02; some folks reported 8-10hr overages. Suggest rebalancing priorities for next two sprints (lower non-critical tech debt).
- Morale: generally positive; onboarding feedback from Carlos/Mei shows good ramp but repeated access friction is a pain point (IAM + security approvals).
- Psychological safety: reminder to interviewers to provide timely feedback (48h target). We still have ~30% of loop feedback coming in >72h. ACTION: Priya to follow up with hiring-ops to add soft reminders in interviewer calendar invites.

4) Scheduling / pipeline / ops
- We need to accelerate loop turnaround: propose blocking 2 interviewers per slot to reduce reschedules. Target: 10-business-day offer velocity for L4 roles.
- Interviewer training: run a 30-min calibration session next Wednesday 2026-03-18 at 9am PT to align on rubric (Priya + hiring-ops). Invite list: all platform interviewers.
- Hiring-ops to prepare candidate comp ranges for A and B candidates by end-of-week (Evelyn coordinating with finance).

5) Action items (owner -> due date)
- Priya: Draft interview rubric for model-serving familiarity -> 2026-03-18 (Confluence page).
- Marcus: Follow up reference check for candidate A -> 2026-03-13.
- Evelyn: Start offer loop for candidate B and coordinate comp -> 2026-03-12.
- Marcus: Create IAM ticket follow-up for Carlos (JIRA-2134) -> 2026-03-11 (in flight).
- Marcus + Sofia: Draft model-serving primer for onboarding -> 2026-03-20.
- Priya + hiring-ops: Add 48h feedback reminders to interviewer invites -> 2026-03-15.
- Evelyn: Escalate KMS access for Mei with security -> 2026-03-12.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we prefer to hire Candidate A at L5 or L4? Marcus suggests L5 based on scale experience but hiring-ops needs budget signoff. (Decision pending finance; flagged JIRA-2108).
- Should we formalize the 2-week paired rotation as part of L4/L5 onboarding? Discuss with managers and make a pilot for Q2.

Quick links referenced:
- Onboarding checklist (Confluence): CONFLUENCE-ENG-ONBOARD-2026
- Hiring tracker (JIRA board): JIRA-2108, JIRA-2134
- PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/512 (Mei's alert noise PR)
- Slack hiring thread: #eng-hiring

Notes to self / informal:
- Keep loop strict on 48h feedback; possible small automation: reminder bot that pings after 36h. Hiring-ops to explore.
- Consider small referral bonus tweak for infra hires; talk to people ops.

Next sync: 2026-03-18 10:00 PT (30 min) - focus on rubric calibration + offer approvals

End of notes.
